prompt: Implement a small human-decision model for ADE. Add src/ade/decisions.py containing a DecisionPriority StrEnum with P0, P1, P2, P3 and an immutable DecisionRequest dataclass with decision_id, question, options, priority, blocking_task_id, and context. Validate that decision_id, question, and blocking_task_id are non-empty and that options contains at least two unique non-empty strings. Add focused tests using Python standard-library unittest only. Do not add dependencies. Do not modify GOAL.md, SPEC.md, ACCEPTANCE.md, ROADMAP.md, pyproject.toml, .github/workflows, or any .autodev files. Run exactly PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v before finishing.
title: Add ADE human decision model
